digest.component_or_area: dependency management and CI gating (uv lock, pip-audit)
propositions: A committed lock freezes transitive dependencies, causing any published advisory against a pinned version to fail the gating pip-audit job on all in-flight changes regardless of code changes.

uv's universal resolution with capping dependencies (e.g., inspect-ai holding click 8.2.1) can freeze the entire project on a vulnerable version, triggering simultaneous CI failures across unrelated work streams.
constraint-dependencies only narrows existing constraints and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected behavior; override-dependencies is the correct instrument to replace an offending upstream cap.
The pip-audit job's retry logic only retries DB-unreachable failures, preventing re-check of real findings and creating confusion about whether an advisory is genuine or a transient failure.

Override directives must carry a REMOVE-WHEN condition and include evidence (upstream fix confirmation, version compatibility verification) to avoid outliving their justification and causing future silent masking of advisories.
